items: 𝐏𝐨𝐰𝐞𝐫 𝐁𝐚𝐧𝐤 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐖𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐏𝐥𝐮𝐠：Recharge the portable charger in two ways: via the built-in AC wall plug (100-240V) for a full charge in 5 hours, or use the USB-C (PD18W) port for a faster 4-hour charge. The power bank can simultaneously charge your phone while recharging the battery pack itself, offering maximum convenience

𝐔𝐥𝐭𝐫𝐚-𝐏𝐨𝐫𝐭𝐚𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐁𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐭-𝐢𝐧 𝐂𝐚𝐛𝐥𝐞𝐬：Designed for on-the-go use, this power bank with built-in cable features an ultra-slim profile (0.78 inches thick) and lightweight (0.5 pounds), making the external battery easy to carry in your pocket or palm. With a 10,000mAh capacity, the battery bank provides 2-3 full charges for most Android phones, Samsung devices, for iPhone models. Built-in USB-C cables eliminate the need for extra cords, ensuring hassle-free travel

𝐏𝐃𝟑.𝟎 & 𝐐𝐂𝟒.𝟎 𝐇𝐢𝐠𝐡-𝐒𝐩𝐞𝐞𝐝 𝐂𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐠：Equipped with three fast-charging ports—USB-A2 (18W), built-in USB-C cable (20W), and USB-C port (PD20W)—this portable fast charger delivers rapid charging. For example, this fast charging power bank can charge an iPhone 13 from 0% to 50% in just 25 minutes, ensuring your devices are always ready to go

𝐂𝐨𝐦𝐩𝐚𝐜𝐭 & 𝐒𝐚𝐟𝐞 𝐃𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐠𝐧：The USB C battery bank's compact size makes the slim portable charger power bank perfect for travel, including air travel. The intelligent protection system of the wall-plug portable charger guards against overcharging, short-circuiting, overheating, and over-discharging, ensuring both safety and optimal performance for your devices

𝐒𝐦𝐚𝐫𝐭 𝐋𝐄𝐃 𝐃𝐢𝐠𝐢𝐭𝐚𝐥 𝐃𝐢𝐬𝐩𝐥𝐚𝐲：The digital LED display on the front of the charging bank shows the remaining battery level, allowing you to keep track of the plug in power bank's charge status and recharge it in time. This feature ensures you always know how much power you have left, providing peace of mind during long trips or busy days
